flash_point.calculation_note: Selected 2026-11-11 under the source-selection policy (technical source first). S-OIL 'Lube Base Oil' web page, table 'Typical Properties of aramcoULTRA Base Oil', column 'aramcoULTRA 8', row 'Flash Point,COC ,℃', ASTM cell 'D92'. Read on the two saved copies in reconciliation/audit_evidence/: SOIL_LubeBaseOil__wayback_20260610070302.html (Internet Archive capture 2026-06-10, SHA-256 cff0d3bbb7964c7450a1b9fa813617bf76e4b09de39187d026f674c7604fda60) and SOIL_LubeBaseOil_live_2026-10-30.html (live page retrieved 2026-10-30, SHA-256 94b263ad23cfd8b9631b5b637635c0cbdb341aad25cb7553a2a44513f10f011c); both print the same cell. The page prints no publication or revision date: its edition date is unknown, and a capture or retrieval date is not an edition date. The archived SDS DL2-14611.pdf (2018-09-07) prints the range 240 ~ 260 °C (ASTM D 92); it is kept as an alternate entry. The typical value lies inside that range: logically compatible, which is not evidence of agreement (the kind of the SDS range is not stated; the SDS prints the method number only, the page also prints COC).
